title: Article page: hotkey nav, a left rail with title, TREE, an ASCII progress bar, read time and SHARE, and a reading column with a mono section head, prose and a list with bold lead terms
use: One article of a developer blog at 1440 x 900. progress sets the bar and the percent, current the bold TREE item, tree_items how many TREE rows show.

mascot.note: the site's mascot, small (36 x 36); your own art

rail_title.default: Teaching a test harness to explain its own failures

tree_{i}.note: TREE item; nesting is fixed (1 and 4 flat, 2, 3, 5, 6 nested)

para_1.default: A flaky test is rarely random. It is usually a promise the code never made: that two jobs finish in a fixed order, that a clock only moves forward, that a port is free. We stopped retrying failures and started asking what each one had assumed.

default: on the first line of the report.
so every run starts at the same second.
when two steps must happen in sequence.

para_2.default: Each trace now ends with a one-line verdict written for a person, not a parser. If the verdict is wrong, that is a bug we can reproduce, and the fix lands next to the test that found it.
